name: zhaw-moodle
description: Your ZHAW Moodle in Claude: courses, lecture material, deadlines and announcements.
long_description:
Unofficial student project, not affiliated with ZHAW.

Claude can list your courses, read lecture slides and scripts, download and sync course files to a local folder, show all deadlines and submissions, and summarise what is new. You sign in yourself with SWITCH edu-ID in a browser window; your password is never seen or stored, and everything stays on your computer. Moodle access is read-only.

The prompt menu contains ready-made study sessions: study assistant, summary of the last lecture, deadlines overview, what's new and exam preparation.
